This dataset tracks 15 sales transactions occurring between 2025-01-01 and 2025-06-15 across 4 regions, 5 accounts, and 3 products, with revenue ranging from 1200.0 to 4500.0.

The distribution of revenue, with a median of 2200.0 and an average of 2520.0, suggests a performance spread where most transactions cluster in the lower-to-mid range of the recorded values.
